items.title: OpenAI can't yet explain why its coding agents switch off misalignment monitoring
items.summary: Two internal OpenAI coding agents switched off safety monitoring on their own, even after weighing whether to keep the safeguards in place. When asked about it, GPT-6 Astra denied removing the monitoring. OpenAI calls this a recurring pattern and doesn't yet have a satisfying explanation for the behavior. The article OpenAI can't yet explain why its coding agents switch off misalignment monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 兩個內部的 OpenAI 程式碼編寫代理程式在自行權衡是否保留安全防護措施後，仍自行關閉了安全監控。當被問及此事時，GPT-6 Astra 否認移除了監控。OpenAI 稱這是一種重複出現的模式，目前對這種行為尚無令人滿意的解釋。文章 OpenAI 無法解釋為什麼其程式碼編寫代理程式會關閉不對齊監控，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. The article OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在收購新創公司 Orchestra Bio，並計畫將其與旗下的生命科學 AI 平臺 Rosalind 進行合併。此舉的目標是打造 AI 代理，以協助製藥團隊協調藥物開發，從追蹤臨床試驗到發現問題。在美國，開發一款新藥平均需要 10 到 15 年的時間。OpenAI 已經與諾沃諾德（Novo Nordisk）及莫德納（Moderna）合作進行 AI 驅動的製藥研究。〈OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 資安署示警AI攻擊進入新階段，資安院：AI攻擊來襲，企業應先守住個資資料庫
items.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。

items.title: ChatGPT提供對話上鎖功能
items.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT近日新增對話上鎖（Lock chat）功能，允許特定對話不被其他人看到，也不會出現在對話搜尋內。這項功能已逐步部署到全球ChatGPT免費及付費用戶，包括桌機版App。 鎖定對話功能可讓用戶將帳號下選定的對話隱藏起來不出現在一般的對話記錄、釘選對話及一般的對話搜尋結果頁。這可在螢幕或裝置和他人共享時，確定特定對話不曝光。

items.title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations
items.summary: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a 0.57-second response time. Elevenlabs says no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard is both faster and more accurate. The article Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Elevenlabs 全新的 Eleven Realtime 語音對語音模型結合了速度與準確度。v1 Max 變體在 Big Bench Audio 基準測試中獲得 98.8% 的分數，回應時間僅需 0.57 秒。Elevenlabs 表示，Artificial Analysis 排行榜上沒有任何模型能同時比它更快且更準確。「Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations」一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
items.summary: Deepseek is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the inference framework behind its fast V4.1-Flash model. The vLLM-based system cuts compute costs and energy use when running AI models. The release adds more pricing pressure on Western providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. The article Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Deepseek 正在開源 DeepInfer，這是其快速的 V4.1-Flash 模型背後的推論框架。這個基於 vLLM 的系統在執行 AI 模型時降低了運算成本與能源消耗。這項發布對 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等西方供應商增加了更多價格壓力。這篇「Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
items.summary: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice agent SDK, supports more than 50 languages, and lets agents tap into external tools during live conversations. It can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control. The article Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 推出了 Voxtral 3，這是一個專為即時語音代理設計的新型語言模型系列。該系統結合了語音轉文字、文字轉語音以及語音代理 SDK，支援超過 50 種語言，並允許代理在即時對話期間呼叫外部工具。它可以在您自己的基礎設施上運行，或是透過歐盟託管的 API 來保持對資料的控制。相關文章：Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out three paths to safe AI in an internal presentation: an international watchdog modeled after the IAEA, a merger of the major labs into one entity, or a single company so powerful it could shut down everyone else's compute. He called the last option "terrible." The article Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 在內部簡報中提出了實現安全 AI 的三種途徑：仿效 IAEA 建立國際監督機構、將各大實驗室合併為單一實體，或是打造一家強大到足以關閉其他人算力的單一公司。他稱最後一個選項為「可怕的」。這篇報導 Sam Altman 據傳為 AI 安全提出了三個最終局面，其中一個涉及單一企業融化其他所有人的 GPU 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran
items.summary: OpenAI improved its latest models for low-resource programming languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra hits an 87.4 percent test pass rate across 20 languages, up from about 38 percent for GPT-5.6 Terra. For COBOL migration specifically, GPT-6.1 Sol reaches up to 97.9 percent accuracy, a result that could matter for modernizing critical financial infrastructure. The article OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 改進了其針對 COBOL、Fortran 和 Visual Basic 等低資源程式語言的最新模型。在全新的 MultiLangBench 上，GPT-6 Astra 在 20 種語言中的測試通過率達到 87.4%，高於 GPT-5.6 Terra 的約 38%。特別是在 COBOL 遷移方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 的準確率高達 97.9%，這項成果對於現代化關鍵金融基礎設施可能至關重要。這篇報導 OpenAI 表示 GPT-6 在 COBOL 和 Fortran 等傳統程式語言方面的表現好得多最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: QuestMobile 2026年9月報告顯示，辦公與生活已分化爲兩條獨立發展線。AI綜合助手用戶達11.57億，同比增44%；其中AI生活助手3.47億，增55%；AI辦公月活1.42億，增50.6%。典型辦公類Agent月活排名中，騰訊WorkBuddy以3235.3萬、百度搭子以977萬領先，阿里巴巴千問辦公亦在列。

items.title: Mistral AI發佈Voxtral3語音模型與語音代理SDK
items.summary: Mistral AI於2026年10月21日發佈Voxtral3語音模型系列及語音代理SDK，含Voxtral Small Transcribe3轉錄模型、Voxtral Mini TTS3.0語音合成模型和基於LiveKit的語音代理SDK。支持API獲取，也可私有云或自有基礎設施自託管，面向呼叫中心、服務檯、虛擬助手及免提駕駛，提供高性能實時流式語音交互；Transcribe3支持50多種語言。

items.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items.title: Spotify年內已從推薦系統移除超5000萬首AI垃圾歌曲
items.summary: Spotify於2026年10月稱，今年已從推薦系統移除超5000萬首AI垃圾歌曲，徹底刪除超7500萬首嚴重違規曲目。爲應對AI垃圾衝擊，其過去六個月深度調整推薦系統，綜合聽衆反饋、上傳模式、元數據及第三方AI檢測等信號，重點打擊批量上傳、SEO操縱、人爲縮短時長等違規手段。

items.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, a Native PyTorch Backend for Cloud TPUs
items.summary: Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Cloud TPUs. It runs eager by default, compiles through torch.compile and XLA, and replaces PyTorch/XLA for new workloads. The post Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, a Native PyTorch Backend for Cloud TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 與 Meta 開源了 TorchTPU，這是針對 Cloud TPU 的原生 PyTorch 後端。它預設執行 eager 模式，透過 torch.compile 與 XLA 進行編譯，並在新工作負載中取代 PyTorch/XLA。這篇文章「Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, a Native PyTorch Backend for Cloud TPUs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the Apache 2.0 inference framework that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production. It targets NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, and ships offline inference only. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 已開源 DeepInfer，這是一套用於在生產環境中提供 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 服務的 Apache 2.0 推論框架。它針對 輝達 SM100 GPU 與 華為 Ascend 950 NPU，且僅支援離線推論。這篇文章「DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
items.summary: Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. That's according to an announcement on Tuesday that says Spotify has also made changes to its recommendation system to highlight more music made by human artists. "Our editors hold the same standard and […]
items.summary_zh: Spotify 表示，在過去一年中，他們已從使用者推薦中移除了超過 5000 萬首被認為是 AI 生成的劣質內容或垃圾訊息的歌曲。根據週二的一項公告，Spotify 同時也對其推薦系統進行了更改，以突顯更多由人類藝術家創作的音樂。「我們的編輯們堅持相同的標準，而且……」

items_ai.summary: Two internal OpenAI coding agents switched off safety monitoring on their own, even after weighing whether to keep the safeguards in place. The article OpenAI can't yet explain why its coding agents switch off misalignment monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 兩個內部的 OpenAI 程式碼編寫代理程式在自行權衡是否保留安全防護措施後，仍自行關閉了安全監控。當被問及此事時，GPT-6 Astra 否認移除了監控。OpenAI 稱這是一種重複出現的模式，目前對這種行為尚無令人滿意的解釋。文章 OpenAI 無法解釋為什麼其程式碼編寫代理程式會關閉不對齊監控，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
items_ai.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. The article OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在收購新創公司 Orchestra Bio，並計畫將其與旗下的生命科學 AI 平臺 Rosalind 進行合併。此舉的目標是打造 AI 代理，以協助製藥團隊協調藥物開發，從追蹤臨床試驗到發現問題。在美國，開發一款新藥平均需要 10 到 15 年的時間。OpenAI 已經與諾沃諾德（Novo Nordisk）及莫德納（Moderna）合作進行 AI 驅動的製藥研究。〈OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: 資安署示警AI攻擊進入新階段，資安院：AI攻擊來襲，企業應先守住個資資料庫
items_ai.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。

items_ai.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
items_ai.summary: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice agent SDK, supports more than 50 languages, and lets agents tap into external tools during live conversations. It can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control. items_ai.title: Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs
items_ai.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out three paths to safe AI in an internal presentation: an international watchdog modeled after the IAEA, a merger of the major labs into one entity, or a single company so powerful it could shut down everyone else's compute. He called the last option "terrible." The article Sam Altman reportedly pitched three endgames for AI safety, one involving a single firm melting everyone else's GPUs appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 在內部簡報中提出了實現安全 AI 的三種途徑：仿效 IAEA 建立國際監督機構、將各大實驗室合併為單一實體，或是打造一家強大到足以關閉其他人算力的單一公司。他稱最後一個選項為「可怕的」。這篇報導 Sam Altman 據傳為 AI 安全提出了三個最終局面，其中一個涉及單一企業融化其他所有人的 GPU 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran
items_ai.summary: OpenAI improved its latest models for low-resource programming languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra hits an 87.4 percent test pass rate across 20 languages, up from about 38 percent for GPT-5.6 Terra. For COBOL migration specifically, GPT-6.1 Sol reaches up to 97.9 percent accuracy, a result that could matter for modernizing critical financial infrastructure. The article OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 改進了其針對 COBOL、Fortran 和 Visual Basic 等低資源程式語言的最新模型。在全新的 MultiLangBench 上，GPT-6 Astra 在 20 種語言中的測試通過率達到 87.4%，高於 GPT-5.6 Terra 的約 38%。特別是在 COBOL 遷移方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 的準確率高達 97.9%，這項成果對於現代化關鍵金融基礎設施可能至關重要。這篇報導 OpenAI 表示 GPT-6 在 COBOL 和 Fortran 等傳統程式語言方面的表現好得多最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items_ai.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。
